visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page lead band with image, H1, serif title line, teaser text, price and CTAs (product pages and the landing page)
visualCharacteristics.layout: Image beside a teaser panel; image left by default, right with image-right; coloured band behind the teaser

contentPattern.structure: image; optional stoerer badge image; H1; title line paragraph; teaser paragraphs; optional price paragraph (bold amount); CTA paragraphs (strong link primary, em link secondary, optional :icon: token)

usage: Top of landing, product (program) and service pages
reuseGuidance: Reuse hero for new pages with the same content pattern; add an option class rather than a new block for colour or layout differences.
